audit.whatIsWrong: The entry puts Ryze's root on the wrong ability all the way through: 'hold W for his Q root', 'his E-root can chain into a Q', 'Land his Q-then-E root combo'. Ryze's abilities are never named.
audit.why: Rune Prison (W) is the CC, and by Riot's own text it damages and SLOWS — it only roots if the target already has Flux on them. Flux comes from Spell Flux (E). So the lock is a two-spell sequence, E then W, and it is defeatable at the first step. Telling a Mel player to hold Rebuttal for 'his Q root' points the reflect at the wrong spell entirely.
audit.corrected: Rune Prison (W) roots only through Spell Flux (E); Overload (Q) is the line projectile that bounces off Fluxed targets. Reflect Spell Flux and Rune Prison arrives as a slow.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rebuttal is described as eating 'his Q/E projectiles' without saying which spell matters or why.
audit.why: Overload and Spell Flux are the two projectiles in the kit; Rune Prison is a targeted cast that no reflect touches. Spell Flux is the one worth the barrier, because denying Flux downgrades the root to a slow and stops Overload bouncing. That is a specific, repeatable use of a 38s cooldown rather than a coin-flip.
audit.corrected: Spend Rebuttal on Spell Flux specifically, not on whichever projectile arrives first.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'melee-tier mage' is used to describe his early range, which is vague and slightly wrong.
audit.why: Rune Prison and Spell Flux are both 615 range and he has no dash, while Overload reaches 1000. Mel's Q is 950 and Solar Snare 1000. So he can trade Overload with her at range all day; what he cannot do is start the lock without walking to 615. That is the actual spacing rule of the lane.
audit.corrected: Frame the spacing by the real numbers: 615 for the chain, 1000 for Overload.

edits.after: Your power peak vs a 615-range early Ryze — mana and AP let you chain Q pokes, reflect Spell Flux so Rune Prison only slows, and detonate freely.

edits.before: Ryze is one of your cleanest early lanes — he's basically a melee-tier mage until he stacks mana, and you're a 550-range artillery bully. At level 2 your Q barrage plus Solar Snare's root is a guaranteed punish when he steps up to last-hit; root him and rain Q on him before his Q-E-flux combo is even reliable. Hold W (Rebuttal) for his Q and E — the wall eats those projectiles and fires them back as your damage, blanking his only poke. Don't walk into his minion wave for a greedy auto where his E-root can chain into a Q.
edits.after: Ryze is one of your cleanest early lanes — Rune Prison and Spell Flux both reach only 615 and he has no dash, and you're a 550-range artillery bully. At level 2 your Q barrage plus Solar Snare's root is a guaranteed punish when he steps up to last-hit; root him and rain Q on him before his Flux chain is even reliable. Hold W (Rebuttal) for Spell Flux above all — the wall eats that projectile and fires it back, and an unfluxed Rune Prison is only a slow. Don't walk into his wave for a greedy auto inside 615.
